description: This Swift source file defines a final class 'KeychainStore' that manages secure storage of strings in the iOS Keychain. It provides methods for setting, retrieving, and removing Keychain entries, encapsulated with error handling and using enums for defining storage keys.

classes.name: KeychainStore
classes.description: A singleton class for storing and retrieving sensitive data securely in the iOS Keychain, with predefined keys and methods for management.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Stores a string securely in the Keychain associated with a specified key.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a stored string from the Keychain for a specified key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific key's entry from the Keychain.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all predefined entries (accessToken, refreshToken, accessTokenExpiry) from the Keychain.
